description: IRA owner born in 1952, age 73 in 2025: the first required distribution year.
worked:
IRA owner born 1952-08-20; age attained on the 2025 birthday = 2025 - 1952 = 73. Beneficiary is not a spouse more than 10 years younger, so the Uniform Lifetime Table applies.
Required beginning age (IRC 401(a)(9)(C)(v) as amended by SECURE 2.0): born 1952 -> age 73; first distribution year = 1952 + 73 = 2025.
2025 is the year age 73 is reached (the first distribution year; it may be taken as late as April 1 of the next year, but it is the RMD for 2025).
Uniform Lifetime Table (26 CFR 1.401(a)(9)-9(c)), age 73: distribution period 26.5.
RMD = account balance at December 31, 2024, 500,000 / 26.5 = 18867.9245, rounded to the cent = 18,867.92.
